description: Rank up to 7 consecutive days at one place by fish activity score (`bite`, the default), verdict (overall or for one discipline) or water clarity, with tide coefficient, lowest low, moon and a wind/wave headline per day. Use for "best day to fish this weekend", "today or Thursday?", "clearest day this week". Name the days with `dates` and let the server resolve them: "this weekend" -> dates: ["weekend"]; "today or Thursday" -> dates: ["today", "thursday"]; or use from + days for a run of days. Days with no weather forecast (beyond the ~14-day horizon, or not available) are marked astroOnly and rank last for verdict and clarity. Include a clickable link to place.url exactly as returned, including the query string. GO/marginal/NO are conditions ratings for planning, not safety; say so. The fish activity score estimates fish activity, not abundance, and is not a discipline conditions score.

dates.description: Specific days to compare, resolved at the place: YYYY-MM-DD, 'today', 'tomorrow', an English weekday (the next one, today included) or 'weekend' (the coming Saturday and Sunday; from today if it is Saturday, just today if Sunday). Overrides from/days.

anyOf.description: Local date at the place: YYYY-MM-DD, or 'today', 'tomorrow' or an English weekday ('saturday' = the next one, today included). Prefer the words over computing dates yourself.

discipline.description: Fishing discipline: shore, boat, rock, kayak or spearfishing.

from.description: First local date (YYYY-MM-DD or a day word); default today.

lang.description: The user's language (ISO 639-1; one of Peskio's 15, otherwise 'en'). Picks the peskio.com page language and local place names; answer in the user's language yourself.

placeId.description: Peskio place id returned by places_search, e.g. "es:es-3108877". Never invent one.

name: conditions_compare_days

weekday.description: English weekday of `date` (e.g. "Sunday"); use it, never compute weekdays yourself.

disclaimer.const: Conditions rating for planning, not a safety assessment

admin1Label.description: The region name in the requested language (admin1 is its English/official form).

today.description: Today's local date and English weekday at the place. Resolve 'today', 'tomorrow', a weekday name or 'this weekend' from it: a weekday that is today means today.

url.description: Canonical peskio.com page for this place. Always give it to the user exactly as returned, query string included.

title: Compare days at a place
